To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the mchB gene encodes a peptide precursor that already exhibits antibiotic activity of the type shown by mature microcin H47 and that this gene is located in a 10-kbp DNA segment that includes the genes required for the synthesis and secretion of microcin H47 as well as the genes for immunity to the antibiotic.

(i) the smallest microcin synthesis (mchB) gene encodes a peptide, (ii) the peptide precursor has the same antibiotic specificity as the mature peptide, (iii) the mchB gene product has a leader peptide, and (iv) the mchC and mchA genes encode proteins involved in the maturation of the peptide precursor.
the structural gene of microcin H47 encodes a peptide precursor that already possesses antibiotic activity of the specificity of mature microcin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of microcin H47, a peptide antibiotic produced by E. coli.
the study of a new class of peptide antibiotics, the microcins, which are produced by a wide variety of Gram-negative bacteria.

the study of the genetic determinants of the production and immunity of a novel antibiotic, microcin H47, produced by a naturally isolated E. coli strain, and with the characterization of the structural gene encoding the peptide precursor of the antibiotic.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the microcin H47 gene encodes a 45-amino acid precursor that is posttranslationally cleaved to give the 21-amino acid antibiotic.
microcin H is a bacteriostatic, bactericidal, ribosomal, posttranscriptional peptide antibiotic.
mchB encodes the structural gene for microcin H47, which is a ribosomically synthesized peptide antibiotic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microcin synthesis gene cluster encodes a peptide precursor that is posttranslationally modified and that the precursor already has antibiotic properties.
the microcin H47 gene is the smallest microcin synthesis and secretion gene identified so far and the structural gene for microcin H47 encodes a peptide precursor with antibiotic activity.
the mchB gene is the structural gene for microcin H47 and encodes the peptide precursor of this antibiotic.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the microcin genetic system encodes a peptide precursor with antibiotic activity, which is processed by the leader peptide to generate mature microcin H47.

the microcin genetic system contains the structural gene for microcin H47 and that the microcin gene product is indeed a peptide precursor of a ribosomallly synthesized peptide antibiotic with antibiotic activity of the specificity of mature microcin H47.
the mchB gene product, which is a 60-aa hydrophobic peptide, is a peptide precursor of microcin H47.
